# REQ: LANG-1851 LANG-1852 LANG-1853 LANG-1854 LoadModule rewrite_module modules/mod_rewrite.so <VirtualHost *:443> ServerName example.com DocumentRoot "/var/www/html" SSLEngine on <Directory "/var/www/html"> Options -Indexes +FollowSymLinks AllowOverride All Require all granted </Directory> RewriteEngine On RewriteRule ^/old/(.*)$ /new/$1 [R=301,L] ErrorLog ${APACHE_LOG_DIR}/error.log </VirtualHost>
